note: What a server sends to break off an attack a unit is making. The header names the unit acting.

fields.name: missile
fields.note: The missile the attack would have thrown, where there is one.

bits.name: keepAnimating
bits.note: Set to let the attack's animation play on after the stop.

bits.name: forceCast
bits.note: Set to make the attack land first where it has not yet.

bits.name: forceStop
bits.note: Set to stop the attack outright; a client does so anyway, reading keepAnimating and forceCast as clear, where it cannot see the unit.

bits.name: summonerSpell
bits.note: Set where the slot stopped is a summoner spell's.

bits.name: destroyMissile
bits.note: Set to destroy the missile named in missile, where it exists; forced, after the attack landed, the spell's cooldown is also refunded.

bits.name: completeCast
bits.note: A client does not read it.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

revisions.note: Whatever the flags, a client then clears the unit's attack.

fields.name: missile
fields.note: The missile the attack would have thrown, where there is one.

bits.name: keepAnimating
bits.note: Set where the unit finishes what it was doing to look at. Clear in everything observed.

bits.name: destroyMissile
bits.note: Set where the missile named above is to go too. Set in everything observed.

bits.name: unknown1
bits.note: Purpose undetermined. Set in everything observed.

bits.name: summonerSpell
bits.note: Set where what is broken off came from a summoner slot. Clear in everything observed.
